manual.label: Approved E3 experience
manual.instruction: Confirm the experience and completed reflection with the major or college, and check the milestone in your official record.

manual.label: CALS residence and graduation GPA
manual.instruction: Confirm full-time residence including the final fall or spring semester, and cumulative GPA of at least 2.00.

manual.label: Official credit record
manual.instruction: Confirm special studies, forbidden overlaps, institutional credit limits and approved CALS equivalents. The planner uses the published credit minimum for the selected curriculum.

manual.label: Transfer credit and adjusted minimums
manual.instruction: Use the official credit evaluation for approved courses, the eligible quarter-system credit exception, and any legacy letter-graded or structured-credit proration.
